722641101.text: I leave Kichiboushi in your trusty hands. He is quite wise. Once he grows older, I plan to pass my titles of "Bake-Danuki King" and "Protector of the Grove" unto him.

722641102.text: So, please take good care of him. Make sure he doesn't catch a cold!

722640101.text: Hmm, even though we managed to raise that huge pillar on the mountaintop...

722640102.text: D—Dragonspine is just... super c—cold no matter how many times we come here... Ugh...

722640105.text: Not afraid of the cold, Kichiboushi?

722640106.text: It's v—very cold. Very very cold.

722640107.text: Come on! Why'd you call Paimon weak, then?

722640109.text: White... Oh, you mean the snow!

722640110.text: "Snow"? Things fall from Sacred Sakura... "Sakurafubuki"... Snow?

722640111.text: No, no. Snow is the super cold stuff around Dragonspine.

722640112.text: Huh, but Paimon didn't expect that you knew of sakurafubuki, Kichiboushi. Guess that's the bake-danuki of Inazuma for you, huh.

722640115.text: Mountain with snow to be cold? Or the cold mountain has snow?

722640117.text: #Um, that's a good question, actually. What do you think snow's actually made of, {NICKNAME}?

722640119.text: Hmm. If that's the case, the Hydro elements must've frozen and become snow because the place is too cold.

722640128.text: We should probably ask someone knowledgeable like Lisa about this stuff in the future.

722640129.text: Dragonspine really is cold, though. When we were last trying to reach the summit, Paimon was so cold that her brain almost stopped working...

722640130.text: But the view's great, though! Since we can see this place from Mt. Yougou, we could probably see Mt. Yougou from Dragonspine's summit, too!

722640131.text: And Starglow Cavern's really deep, too. Maybe we might find some never-before-seen treasure in there...

722640133.text: Looks like the two of you will get along well, Paimon.

722640134.text: Hehe, well, there's no good life or food without treasure! Kichiboushi's pretty smart, huh?

722640136.text: Hey, don't catch a cold now!

722640137.text: If you run into any danger...

722640122.text: Eh? If that's the case, the Cryo elements within the snow must be making this place colder...

722640126.text: Still, Paimon doubts that Kaeya's that strong.

722640219.text: Hmm. If that's the case, the Hydro elements must've frozen and become snow because the place is too cold.

722640228.text: We should probably ask someone knowledgeable like Lisa about this stuff in the future.

722640229.text: Dragonspine's freezing, but unlike other places in Mondstadt, the air here is very refreshing. Really good for clearing our heads!

722640230.text: There's a lot of places here that we haven't been to, too.

722640231.text: #If we've got a chance in the future, {NICKNAME}, we should go further into Dragonspine — we might find some treasure long-buried beneath the ice!

722640233.text: Looks like the two of you will get along well, Paimon.

722640234.text: Hehe, well, there's no good life or food without treasure! Kichiboushi's pretty smart, huh?

722640236.text: Hey, don't catch a cold now!

722640237.text: If you run into any danger...

722640222.text: Eh? If that's the case, the Cryo elements within the snow must be making this place colder...

722640226.text: Still, Paimon doubts that Kaeya's that strong.

722640902.text: Huh, but it was either Gyoubu Koban or Shousei who turned into a torch the previous time. Do you tanuki enjoy turning into torches?

722640903.text: Become human things, can play with humans.

722640904.text: Or else, humans not play with Kichiboushi.

722640905.text: #Don't you worry, Kichiboushi! {NICKNAME} and Paimon will play with you!

722640907.text: But there's a cliff ahead of us right now. Would you like us to carry you over?

722640910.text: Kichiboushi creates what seems to be an airbag.\nUsing its powers of flotation and the chilling winds of Dragonspine, he floats to the other side of the cliff.

722640911.text: ...Whoa, what in the world was that?

722640302.text: Argh, this guy isn't cute at all!

722640305.text: Hmm, how should we put it? Laughing's good, yeah, but laughing at other people isn't.

722640306.text: It's only good if everyone can laugh together.

722640309.text: #Paimon's name is Paimon, and {F#Big Sis}{M#Big Bro} Yellow Fur is {NICKNAME}. You've got to remember that, Kichiboushi!

722640310.text: Difficult to remember. Bothersome, White Fur and Yellow Fur.

722640312.text: Well, no need to force yourself either.

722640313.text: Still, what was that trick Kichiboushi used? One moment he created that balloon with a "swoosh," and then "swish," he went floating right over. It looked pretty cool!

722640315.text: What in the world is that? Ugh, Paimon's not really getting Kichiboushi again.

722640320.text: White Fur and Yellow Fur, not have?

722640321.text: White Fur flip-flap, Yellow Fur flip-flap. So White Fur and Yellow Fur, having.

722640323.text: It might be a bake-danuki ability of some sort.

722640324.text: Mm. Snow mountain fun! Go, go!

722640319.text: What is that even supposed to mean!?

722640501.text: Yellow Fur, powerful. Very, very strong!

722640505.text: Oh, right! Did the picture come out okay?

722640506.text: You show Kichiboushi and Paimon the picture you just took.

722640511.text: Snow mountain has bake-danuki? But no smell.

722640512.text: Um, that's not quite it. Dragonspine doesn't have any bake-danuki. This is just you, Kichiboushi?

722640515.text: (You explain the concept of a photo to Kichiboushi!)

722640516.text: So it's artwork! White Fur silly. Mmhaha!

722640517.text: Ugh. This is kinda annoying, but Paimon doesn't know how to refute him either...

722640518.text: Kichiboushi stop laughing. Only laugh together good.

722640520.text: Good Kichiboushi! You get a gold star!

722640522.text: Mm... Then let's stop here for now. You're tired too, aren't you, Kichiboushi?

722640524.text: That let's go back and report to Ioroi, shall we? He did seem pretty worried about this whole thing.

722640404.text: Well, no. Just trapped in ice, y'know? Dragonspine is a super cold place, after all.

722640406.text: #Hmm, speaking of which, do you wanna take a picture of Kichiboushi here, {NICKNAME}?

722640409.text: Hehe, well, we never know when you'll come around here again, so it would be nice to leave a memory of your trip! It'll also help us prove to Ioroi that we did take you traveling!

722640410.text: Alrighty then! Stay right there, Kichiboushi!

722640601.text: Ooh, you've returned! Nothing hurt withall? No colds caught? Not hungry, I hope?

722640602.text: Well, Paimon wouldn't say no to some food...

722640603.text: It went quite smoothly, not to worry.

722640604.text: Mm! Snow cold, but very fun.

722640605.text: Ah yes, we've brought a souvenir with us, too!

722640606.text: You show Ioroi the picture of Kichiboushi on Dragonspine.

722640607.text: Ahhh! Kichiboushi! Why is Kichiboushi sealed upon this vellum?

722640608.text: Is... Is this a Hell Painting? How comes it into your hands? How?

722640611.text: Oh, come on, stop picking on Ioroi already. That's a "photo," and it's a kind of drawing. Look over there. Kichiboushi's fine, isn't he?

722640615.text: Eh? Two Kichiboushis... But how? What magic is this?

722640616.text: ...Ooh! I understand! It's magic, isn't it? Hahaha, much progress have you made in so short a time, Kichiboushi!

722640618.text: Ugh... Let us explain, would you?

722640619.text: You spend a bit more time explaining how photos work to Ioroi.

722640620.text: Ah, but am I not the world-renowned king of bake-danuki? Of course I knew what this "Kimera" was! I was merely testing Kichiboushi!

722640623.text: Ahem. Well, whatever the case, it appears that Kichiboushi's training proceeds most well indeed.

722640703.text: Yellow Fur very strong. Kapow — big and round thing gone.

722640704.text: That's because I train regularly, you know?

722640705.text: Mm! Kichiboushi, become strong like Yellow Fur!

722640707.text: What do you plan to do once you become stronger, Kichiboushi?

722640708.text: Get back at Gyoubu Koban, mmhaha!

722640710.text: Good luck. As for your training route, just leave it to us.
